subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `normalizeMessageActionRequest` as a permanent public channel-plugin SDK hook for this Telegram repair, or require a narrower owner-scoped design?
rationale: The branch changes a generated Plugin SDK surface rather than only Telegram-local behavior; tests can show the implementation works, but they cannot determine whether this becomes the supported long-term extension contract.

options.title: Approve the generic hook
options.body: Accept the channel-owned normalization hook after final-head proof and document it as the supported pre-dispatch extension point.

options.title: Require a narrower seam
options.body: Keep the repair Telegram-local or introduce a more constrained generic contract if maintainers do not want arbitrary action/argument normalization in the SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic hook
recommendation.body: Accept the channel-owned normalization hook after final-head proof and document it as the supported pre-dispatch extension point.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior gateway/channel-action routing work introduced the adjacent public adapter seam that this PR extends.
